# mtncloud_router_types (Data Source)

Lists router types available to the authenticated account, including creation capabilities and type-specific option metadata. No name or code is required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_router_types" "available" {}

output "router_types" {
  value = jsondecode(data.mtncloud_router_types.available.types_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `types_json` (String) JSON array of router types with id, name, code, creatable, hasNetworkServer, and optionTypes. Use jsondecode to inspect the options returned by Morpheus.
